stopping_scope: This is exactly one finite representative rescue within Round2. Do not add another automatic calibration loop, new guard or tuning grid after seeing validation losses.

After valid source/tooling/data closure, the same prospective two-percent paired PG16 criterion can reject this refreshed adopted configuration under its declared finite calibration budget. An asymptotic plateau is not required for that bounded budget claim.

A breach does not prove every guarded, retrained or larger-budget context-bank family impossible; the calibration regime and failing model must remain in the failure unit. Old Stage0/1 inconclusive findings are unchanged.
An optional TRAIN-distance85 guard, if kept, is fixed secondary only; it neither rescues nor triggers the primary unguarded stopping rule. Guard coverage by itself is not a latency failure.
A quality pass supports only partial deployment expansion. Overlapping intervals remain inconclusive; neither outcome justifies source/TEST access or another refit without its own declared scope.
